articles.title: AI100 report: AI has entered the mainstream and is reshaping society
articles.description: Artificial intelligence has moved from a specialized technology to an everyday reality for millions of people. According to the latest report from the One Hundred Year Study on Artificial Intelligence (AI100), the past five years have marked a watershed moment in AI's development, driven by advances in large-scale computing, vast datasets and the rapid rise of generative AI.

articles.description: arXiv:2611.09951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence.
